Watches for the option market paying up for far out-of-the-money puts, either on outright level or on a fast stretch versus its own recent range. SKEW at or above 140 is in place.

Missing is SKEW stretched (z20 at or above 1.5), so the level is elevated but not accelerating. What kills it is SKEW rolling back under the level while the stretch never arrives; what escalates it is the stretch showing up while the level holds, which is when the composite gets loud.
